findings.label: Duplicate setLoading(true) sources in Deployments
findings.detail: fetchDeployments now calls setLoading(true) on every invocation including re-fetches; confirm this does not flash a skeleton over already-rendered data on scope changes. Cosmetic only.

findings.label: Logs relies on isConnected gating rather than initialized directly
findings.detail: fetchLogsData early-returns while !isConnected; the added initialized/activeCluster?.id deps make it re-fire correctly when the cluster resolves, but the two gates coexist. Works as written; worth a glance if Logs ever shows stale empty state.
